notes: Puts the parts together into the file, which then is in the library; id is the file's id, for its thumbnail (PUT /api/files/{id}/thumb). Safe to send again, e.g. after a lost answer or Cloudflare's 524 on a long one: a finished upload answers the same. 409 s3_parts_missing while a part is missing or has the wrong size: GET the state, send what's missing, complete again. 404 not_found: start the file again. 503 s3_unavailable with Retry-After while the bucket can't be reached; the parts stay. DELETE /api/s3/uploads/{id} cancels an unfinished upload (204), and answers 403 forbidden once it is finished.
